items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 哈…睡得好香呀。欸，你好呀，旅行者，我们又见面了。嗯？不记得我了？嘿嘿，那就让我再次加入你的旅程吧。你的诗篇，值得被我这个世上最好的吟游诗人传唱！
items.text_en: *Yawn* That was a refreshing sleep. Ah, Traveler, we meet again! What? You don't remember me? Ahaha, well, allow me to join you on your quest once again. I must see to it that the bards of the world tell the Traveler's tales!

items.title: 闲聊·弹琴
items.text: 嗯…想接着听下去的话，送我一个苹果吧。
items.text_en: Sure, I'll play you another tune, but it'll cost you an apple.

items.title: 闲聊·苹果酒
items.text: 嗯…好想坐在大树上，手边有喝不完的苹果酒。哎。
items.text_en: Right now I wish I was sitting at the top of a tree, looking out over a meadow, cider in hand...

items.title: 闲聊·诗篇
items.text: 动身吧，旅行者。佚失的诗篇，还在等着我们呢。
items.text_en: Come on Traveler, let's go! The world is full of lost ballads just waiting to be rediscovered.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 等雪积起来…我们来打雪仗吧！
items.text_en: Let's wait till the snow gets heavier and have a snowball fight!

items.title: 雨过天晴
items.text: 欸~这就天晴了？我还想多玩一会儿呢。
items.text_en: It's stopped raining already? A shame, I wanted to play some more.

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 来踩小水坑吧！看看谁溅出来的水花更大！
items.text_en: Let's go jumping in puddles and see who can make the biggest splash!

items.title: 刮大风了
items.text: 难得呀，要不要去飞一飞？
items.text_en: The wind has returned! Quick, let's go gliding!

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早，准备开始新的冒险了么？
items.text_en: Morning! Ah... what's in store for today?

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 咕…肚子饿了，又不敢再去晨曦酒庄蹭饭…啊，是你呀！欸嘿，要出门么？带我一个呗。
items.text_en: My tummy is rumbling, but I can't get caught pilfering food from the Dawn Winery again... Oh, it's you! Where are you heading? May I join?

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 我还不困哦。要我陪你走走么？
items.text_en: Hmm, I'm still not sleepy. Fancy an evening stroll?

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 欸？要休息了吗？嘿嘿，晚安。
items.text_en: Off to the land of nod? Haha, farewell, my friend!

items.title: 关于温迪自己
items.text: 练习？哼哼，我当然不需要啦，在这提瓦特就没有我不会唱的歌。
items.text_en: Practice? Me? There's no need — I already know every song in Teyvat!

items.title: 关于我们·新歌
items.text: 我想把你写进新歌里！欸，怎么露出这种表情呀，担心付不起稿费吗？哈哈，摩拉就不要了，不如…跟我再讲讲你的故事吧！
items.text_en: I have decided to write a song about you! What are you giving me that look for? Can't afford it? Don't be preposterous, the price for you, my friend, is precisely zero Mora! Although... one thing you could do is tell me a few more of your stories!

items.title: 关于我们·勇者
items.text: 唔…嗯！嘿嘿，等到勇者救出了王子/公主，我会第一时间让全大陆传唱这首歌谣。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Haha, once the hero/heroine in the song has actually rescued the princess/prince, I will ensure this song spreads to every corner of the continent!

items.title: 关于我们·使徒
items.text: 夜风凉爽，是适合成为神的使徒的天气！那么事不宜迟，快来向我献上供奉吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Complete "Song of the Dragon and Freedom"Ahh... an evening breeze really sets the mood for becoming my disciple, don't you think? We can do it right now... you just need to make me a small offering...

items.title: 关于我们·请求
items.text: 欸，要风神我更加努力一点？那你是不是也要展示点诚意呢。比如虔诚、热爱，或者说…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Complete "Song of the Dragon and Freedom"What's that? You think I should try harder to be a good Anemo Archon? Well, you could be a better devotee too... you could be more pious, more passionate, or... um...

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 欸？好奇我的「神之眼」？喔…喏，给你。喜欢的话…要我给你做一个一样的么？嘿嘿嘿。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Hmm? You want to know about my Vision? Oh, go on then, take a look for yourself. I can make you a matching one if you like! Hehehe.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: Olah！嘿嘿，这是丘丘人打招呼用的话哦。问我学这个干嘛？哎呀，为了创作，知识面当然越广越好啊。唔，好像，我还没尝试过用丘丘语写歌呢…
items.text_en: Olah! Haha, that's how the Hilichurls say "hello." Why, I learned it to aid with my songwriting, of course! Vast knowledge makes for a richer composition... That said, I haven't actually written any songs in Hilichurlian so far...

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 旅行者，你见过塞西莉亚花么？那是一种只在安静的山崖顶上默默绽放的白色野花。在我心里，它就是全提瓦特最美的花。
items.text_en: Traveler, have you ever seen a Cecilia? It's a magnificent white wildflower that only grows on the most remote mountains and clifftops. To me, at least, it is the most beautiful flower in all of Teyvat.

items.title: 关于琴
items.text: 骑士团代理团长大人…你觉得她是个怎样的人？嘿嘿，跟我想得一样。认真，勇敢，也不乏温柔。和我一个朋友有点像呢…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Acting Grand Master Jean... Well, what do you think of her? Yes, I couldn't agree more: conscientious, courageous... kind and considerate too. Reminds me of another good friend...

items.title: 关于迪卢克
items.text: 去跟迪卢克老爷处好关系吧？你想，他家可是有好~多~珍藏的酒啊！嘿嘿嘿，嘿嘿嘿嘿…咦，无论如何不准喝酒么？那…就去闻一闻吧，闻一闻！只是闻的话，你也可以喔。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I'm not surprised you want to befriend Master Diluc. Just think of all the vintage wine he must have stored away... Mwuhahaha... Huh? He doesn't let you sample it? Not even the slightest drop? Huh... Well, I guess you can still appreciate the aroma. That's still better than no wine at all, right? No?

items.title: 关于芭芭拉
items.text: 唱歌很好听的牧师女孩儿，你认识么、你认识么？…唔，偶像？…啊，握手会？…嗯，专场live？…这样啊，音乐还真是深奥呐。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The darling Deaconess with the sweet singing voice — do you know her? You do? Idol, huh? Meet and greets? Concerts? Wow... That's the power of music for you...

items.title: 关于雷泽
items.text: 那个奔狼领的白发少年，哦哦，是吗，是被狼养大的啊…怪不得呢，他身上的气息，令人怀念…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Ah yes, the white-haired fellow from Wolvendom? Raised by wolves? Really? ... No wonder his scent is so familiar...

items.title: 关于莫娜
items.text: 啊，那位占星术士吗？这么说吧，占卜和我的诗歌一样，都是让人穷到酒钱都凑不齐的没用技术呢！欸？你说占星至少是一项文化传统，所以不是没用的？呜，真失礼啊，那诗歌也一样有用啊！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Oh, that astrologer? How should I put it? Fortune-telling and my singing are the same: Both lead to you being so poor you can't even cough up the money for a drink! ...You think that astrology is a cultural tradition, so at least still has some value? Hmph, so rude. In that case, so too is singing, so it still has its value too!

items.title: 关于迪奥娜
items.text: 远近闻名的猫尾酒馆特调酒。可是…呜，会，打，打喷嚏。要不，你帮我讨一杯酒来吧。我肯定会好好感激你的，一言为定。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4There's a special drink known far and wide at Cat's Tail. But it ah... ahh... ACHOO! *sniffs* How about you go and fetch one for me? I'll be truly thankful, I promise.

items.title: 关于阿贝多
items.text: 黑土与白垩、宇宙与地层，无垢之土创生原初之人…特征实在太明显了，难以忽视呀。这么危险的古老技术，万一在城里失控——嗨，算了，就让蒙德人自己解决蒙德的问题吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4How do you explain white chalk in black soil, or the earth's dense crust amidst the emptiness of space? Same reason the purest soil gave birth to human life... It's an ancient power with unmistakable properties. Trying to harness it is dangerous indeed, I can't imagine what would happen if someone lost control of it in the city... Ah, never mind! What goes on within Mondstadt's walls is up to Mondstadt's people to deal with!

items.title: 关于摩拉克斯
items.text: 你见过那位老爷子了？他近来还好吗？欸，变成名叫「钟离」的普通人了？对他那个死脑筋而言，这应该是不小的改变啊。啊，陪我去见见他吧，带上这瓶埋在风起地的陈年好酒当作慰问品。啊对了，他现在还强不强，实力还剩几成啊？我这样过去，应该不会被打飞吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "A New Star Approaches"Have you seen that gentleman around? Huh? He's just a normal man by the name of Zhongli now? That must be quite the change for that old block-head. Come with me to see him, will you? I have a vintage I dug up from Windrise that I can take as a condolence gift. Oh, ahh... did he still seem strong when you saw him? How strong? Am I likely to get blown away?

items.title: 关于优菈
items.text: 优菈对酒的品位可是很不错的。无论夏天、冬天都要喝冰的这一点，在现在的蒙德人里也算难得啦。感觉能和她成为不错的酒友。嗯？你说我编排的劳伦斯家的歌…早已经传到了她的耳朵里？哈，那有什么关系嘛？说不定，我们还能一起唱呢。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Eula has good taste when it comes to beverages of the alcoholic variety. Come summer or winter, she always likes them ice-cold. That's rare among Mondstadters these days! She and I would make great drinking buddies. Huh? My songs about the Lawrence Clan... She's heard them already? Eh, no harm done. Maybe she and I can do a duet sometime!

items.title: 关于巴尔
items.text: 听说，你把那位不可一世的雷电将军也击败了？啊…想当年她作为影武者的时候，就在追求极致的武技了。如今，也一定会借用各种各样的理由叫你做陪练吧。嗯嗯，偷偷告诉你她的弱点吧，耳朵凑过来——是「甜点心」哦！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"So, I hear you defeated the mighty Raiden Shogun? Ah, I recall the days when she was a kagemusha, seeking to perfect her martial prowess. Hehe, she now no doubt employs a wide range of reasoning to get you to train with her. Oh but yes, come close and I shall let you in on her weakness — desserts!

items.title: 关于布耶尔
items.text: 你说草神啊，说到草神，就会先想到她那关于「梦境」的权能吧？与我所作的那些诗歌一样，她所创造的梦境也一样充满了浪漫与想象，我们可是很合得来呢。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises"The first thing you think of when you hear "Dendro Archon" is her power over dreams. Her dreams are akin to my ballads: full of emotion and imagination. It goes without saying that we get along really well.

items.title: 想要了解温迪·其一
items.text: 来得正好，旅行者。我想听听，你的愿望是什么？
items.text_en: Perfect timing, Traveler! I was about to ask you — what is your greatest wish?

items.title: 想要了解温迪·其二
items.text: 跟你一起旅行真是件有趣的事，要说美中不足就是你身边的那只小不点了吧。那么能吃，你们的伙食费很了不得吧？哈哈。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3There's never a dull moment traveling with you! The only minor inconvenience is that pesky little pixie thing that follows you everywhere... She never stops eating — I can't begin to imagine how much you spend on food!

items.title: 想要了解温迪·其三
items.text: 火之神是个横行霸道的战斗狂，岩之神是个不懂人心的死脑筋。问我怎么会知道这些？欸嘿，叙事诗里都写得一清二楚嘛，他们的故事。那个年代的故事。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The Pyro Archon is a wayward, warmongering wretch, and the Geo Archon is a brutish, blundering buffoon! How do I know? Because, this is written in the epic poems of days gone by!

items.title: 想要了解温迪·其四
items.text: 天空岛啊。连我也不一定飞得到那里呢。而且在那里，没有甜的水，也长不出什么好吃的果子。就更不会有好酒咯？嘿嘿，所以请我去我都不想去哦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Celestia... I'm not sure even I could fly that far. In any case, the water there tastes foul, and the fruit is bland. You know what that means? No cider! Haha, in that case, I wouldn't go there even if I was invited.

items.title: 想要了解温迪·其五
items.text: 我的愿望？嗯。以前，我想着要游历整个世界。现在也一样，不过嘛，加上了一份限定条件，那就是跟你一起。有你在，才是完整的。记叙者果然要和冒险者在一起才行嘛，嘿嘿！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6My greatest wish? It has always been to roam free and experience the whole world. Now, I would add that wherever I go, it simply must be with you! Each day with you is an adventure, and where adventurers go, storytellers must follow!

items.title: 温迪的爱好
items.text: 我喜欢酒！还有风！唔，如果能有用风酿的酒就好了。
items.text_en: I like to drink! And I like the wind! If only there were such a thing as wind-brewed cider...

items.title: 温迪的烦恼
items.text: 其实，只要有猫在附近，我就忍不住会打喷嚏…啊-啊-阿嚏！唔…哎呀…就连想一想也不行么…欸，你知不知道该怎么治好这个毛病呀？
items.text_en: I'm actually highly allergic to cats. I start sneezing as soon as they enter the vicinity, and... Aah... Aa-choo! Ugh, apparently I can't even THINK about cats without sneezing. Do you think there is a cure for this monstrous affliction?

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 你也来一个苹果吗，刚摘的。啊呜，啊…又脆又甜，苹果才是神的馈赠吧！
items.text_en: Here, have an apple. I just picked it. Look how ripe and juicy it is... *munching* ... Truly the fruit of the gods.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 哎，你在做什么好吃的吗？欸？热奶酪饼！这个…这个不行，热热的黏糊糊的，唔…对我来说，太腻了…
items.text_en: Hmm, what's that tasty morsel you've got there...? Eww! A melted cheese pancake? A smelly, sticky, slimy, disgusting mess!

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 啊，好满足！明天也会有吧？后天也会有吧？
items.text_en: Ahh, quite delightful! So... could I get the same again tomorrow? ...And maybe the day after that?

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 呼，好饱，连餐后水果都要吃不下了…
items.text_en: Oof, I'm so full... I'll have to pass on the post-meal fruits this time...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 竟然是连我都应付不来的食物。唔…这下可难办了。
items.text_en: I can't believe it, but I don't think I can stomach this... Oh boy... What a predicament.

items.title: 生日
items.text: 我以前听朋友说生日是要吃蛋糕的…喏，苹果蛋糕，给，勺子。烤出来的时候有点塌了，所以看上去像是苹果派。欸嘿，甜点还真是复杂呀。
items.text_en: Someone once told me you're supposed to eat a cake on your birthday... Tada! Here's your birthday cake — it's apple-flavored! And here's a spoon. The cake didn't rise properly in the oven... That's why it looks more akin to an apple pie... Ugh, baking is really quite complicated!

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 欸！刚刚发生了什么！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1Woah! What was that?

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 辛苦啦。想要来点音乐放松一下吗？随想曲，还是小夜曲？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2Good work. Shall we repose for a moment with a tune? Shall it be a capriccio or a serenade?

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 来，坐这边。我写了一首新诗哦，就叫它「旅行者之风」吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4Come, sit with me. I've written a new poem. I call it "Wind of the Traveler."

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 唔…明明这些风景早就看过很多遍了，有你在身边，却像是呈现出了不同的样子。你该不会…还藏着一大堆奇奇怪怪的能力吧？…唔，那倒也不错。说明，我看人的眼光很准呀，欸嘿。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6Hmm... Though I've long since viewed this scenery a great many times, there is something different about seeing it again with you. Surely you're not still concealing some other wondrous abilities? Hmm, even if you were, it would simply further prove that my intuition is correct.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 哟呼——
items.text_en: Yoo-Hoo!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 在这哟。
items.text_en: Here we go!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 留意脚下。
items.text_en: Brace yourselves!

items.title: 元素战技·其四
items.text: 一起来玩吧。
items.text_en: Let's play!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 别想逃开喔？
items.text_en: Think you can get away?

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 起风咯~
items.text_en: Time for takeoff!

items.title: 冲刺开始·其一
items.text: 飞，比跑快吧？
items.text_en: Wouldn't gliding be faster?

items.title: 打开风之翼·其一
items.text: 呀嘿~
items.text_en: Yahoo!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 咳咳，请听一首，「宝箱之歌」！
items.text_en: *clears throat* Have you heard The Ballad of the Treasure Chest?

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 嘿嘿，要不要感谢「风神的眷顾」呀？
items.text_en: Thank Barbatos! Wait a minute...

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 收获不少，可以拿去换几瓶好酒啦。
items.text_en: What a find! I wonder how many bottles this'll be worth...

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 等等，这可不好玩！
items.text_en: Ugh, I'm not in the mood for this!

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 哎呀，别盯着我打呀。
items.text_en: Oh, dear!

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 好过分呐。
items.text_en: That was uncalled for.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 交给我吧。
items.text_en: Let me try!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 还不能放弃哦。
items.text_en: Don't give up!

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 稍微睡一下吧…
items.text_en: Let me sleep a while...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 啊呀，弦断了…
items.text_en: Oh no, my lyre is broken...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 扑通。
items.text_en: Ah... Ugh...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 哎呀…
items.text_en: Ah!

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 好粗鲁哦。
items.text_en: How rude!

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 调音完成。
items.text_en: Give me a moment to compose myself.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 让你久等了哦？
items.text_en: Didn't keep you waiting, did I?

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 是要做热身运动吗。
items.text_en: Ready for a rehearsal?
